Green PDF Reader — Onion folder drop-in
=======================================

Built from master ed74967 (finer H-pan ~1/20 width; V-pan stays
screenful; picker blank-screen fix; Pango Arabic TOC).

Install
-------
1) App/Green/  →  /mnt/SDCARD/App/Green/
2) bin/green/  →  /mnt/SDCARD/.tmp_update/bin/green/
3) PDFs in /mnt/SDCARD/Media/PDF/

lib/*.so.0 are real ELF files (not symlinks) for FAT SD cards.
